title: A clearer profile garage
summary: Profile editing and automatic selection now have focused, roomier workspaces.
highlights: Promoted Automatic Selection to its own workspace page with class cards, assigned wheel images, searchable profile choices, and enable or resume controls.
Combined profile browsing and editing into a cleaner two-pane workspace with flatter navigation and more consistent scrolling.
Made class defaults global to the workspace instead of repeating them inside every profile, while allowing any profile to be assigned and tagged in one step.
